members.statement: The cited explicit map has the form G(U)=U+H(U) over Q^24, with every nonzero component of H homogeneous cubic, determinant 1, 54 nonzero cubic monomials, and a displayed collision of two distinct rational points.
members.title: An explicit cubic-homogeneous counterexample in 24 variables
